patch.value: Queue budgeted human labeling with deterministic uncertainty and diversity selection

Read-only reusable label acquisition workflow over declared abstained and unlabeled cases, preserving source/cohort boundaries and explicit label provenance. Overlap recheck: core SDK owns certified tracker reads and native mutations; existing evaluation ground truth and same-tracker exemplars supply data/context; pm-rl owns training and promotion. No equivalent acquisition queue found in the inspected CLI declarations, pm-jev, pm-context or pm-rl surfaces. This does not enlarge the benchmark or introduce a training backend.

A fixed seed yields the same bounded queue; Held-out sources remain separated; No inferred label becomes ground truth; Selection emits measured candidate and omission counts; Typed SDK and CLI share one strict bounded schema, exact ratio decisions and compact JSON/TOON output with typed refusals and remedies; Seeded 500-sequence model test covers older replays, CRLF, native relationships, SDK state readback and ambient focus; public read-only non-git tracker validation reports measured counts

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck completed against the installed CLI SDK declaration index, CLI extension surfaces, pm-jev evaluation/exemplar paths, pm-context evidence packing and pm-rl corpus/evaluation plans. Existing pm-jev-xgo9 expands independent ground truth; pm-jev-f4ba supplies same-tracker exemplars. This feature supplies a reusable human-label selection workflow only. Plan: one strict portable schema, exact count ratios, seeded deterministic uncertainty ranking plus declared diversity/cost limits, immutable cohort source membership, explicit human/inferred/absent provenance, compact measured omissions. Queue is pure and read-only: no import/sync, native mutation, durable budget, claims, reservation, journal or transaction-isolation claim. Consumers must revalidate live revisions before any later labeling write; commitWorkspaceTransaction alone does not isolate ordinary writers (upstream #1620). Verification: boundary/extreme corpora, 500 model-based sequences and SDK native-state readback in non-git trackers, behavioral revert proof, packed install modes, public read-only tracker measurements; local focused tests/typecheck/lint and CI npm+Bun full release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Focused queue verification passed 8/8 tests, including 500 seeded operation sequences (3000 operations), 500 exact-ratio boundary cases, isolated invalid/duplicate cases, maximum 5000-case/100-slot output and native no-git JSON/TOON. Targeted coverage reports 100% lines/branches/functions for label-schema.ts, label-queue.ts, label-command.ts and bounded-json.ts. Public acceptance on committed unbraind/pm-lint data: 25 items, 56 authoritative files; 13 eligible, 11 selected, 14 omitted (12 below minimum, 2 diversity), 22/30 labeling units spent, 8 remaining, 3 buckets. Separate controls preserved 11 inferred labels, omitted 1 held-out case and 25 human-labeled cases. SDK readback and all authoritative hashes unchanged; zero inference and mutation calls. These annotations measure queue mechanics, not inference quality or native ground truth. Packed acceptance and behavioral revert proof remain before PR.

This touches only portable queue numbers, never native tracker normalization. The prior final-artifact install attempt had a clean-cache dependency-resolution failure before consumers; the unchanged retry passed its first four install modes. Final code/head acceptance is repeated after this small schema correction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Re-review round 1 reproduced a class violation: multiplicity and conflict evidence must be collected before payload validity or eligibility filtering. A valid pending copy remained selectable when a same-(source,id,task) human-labeled copy had invalid cost 0. Clean worktree verified; fetched origin/main is already an ancestor (branch ahead 2, behind 0), so no merge is needed. Reusing this feature item and claim. Audit scope: every package parser with duplicate/seen tracking, SDK and command dispatch, omission diagnostics, JSON/TOON, real non-git state preservation and packed Node/Bun install modes. Plan: extract bounded own-data identity through the same identity validator before payload validation; count all identifiable rows, then quarantine every occurrence of a repeated identity. Malformed rows without trustworthy identity remain isolated invalid-case refusals. Add adversarial/property and transport regressions plus disposable function-revert proof. Supplied review contains one blocking finding; no additional actionable findings are present in GitHub inline review comments or reviews.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class-wide audit completed: only label-schema.ts combined isolated malformed-row admission with duplicate identity counting after payload validation. Replay recordings, cost datasets, drift cohorts and joint constraints reject malformed documents as a whole; a new package-parser regression asserts that a malformed same-id copy never creates partial successful admission in those four parsers. SDK/CLI/host harness all call the same queue parser; no separate TOON or packed validator exists. The fix counts every bounded own-data identity before payload validation and skips every matching occurrence as duplicate_case, including malformed/foreign records. Corpus covers all seven non-identity payload fields (71 variants), both orders, unknown keys, unsupported prototypes/arrays with own data identities, nonfinite values, missing identities and accessors without evaluation. Added 500 seeded malformed-copy injections with JSON/CRLF replay and native SDK readback. Disposable parser-only revert failed the adversarial regression by selecting case-a alongside the unrelated survivor; restoring only parseLabelQueueInput passed the same test (exit 1 then 0). Packed npm/Bun SDK and all five native install modes now carry independent duplicate-quarantine assertions in both JSON and expanded/compact TOON. No existing test was removed or weakened.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The same admission-order audit identified an SDK-boundary variant: dense arrays were validated but returned with caller-controlled prototype iteration methods. Such a map override can replace a malformed conflicting copy with an unidentifiable placeholder before multiplicity counting. Close this variant by snapshotting validated own index data into a plain array in the existing dense schema helper; apply it uniformly to cases, cohorts and source lists, preserving standard JSON and v1 canonical output. Add hostile inherited-map/iterator regressions and a separate dense-helper-only behavioral revert proof. No native tracker parser or public input domain is reimplemented.
